source_text: In Western body modification subcultures, influenced by the "modern primitives" movement of the 1990s onward—which seeks to revive tribal aesthetics through voluntary alterations—penile subincision is occasionally self-performed or sought from specialized practitioners for reasons including aesthetic reconfiguration, enhanced urination mechanics, or intensified sexual sensations via exposure of the urethra. [42]
